failing_job_findings.cause: The Redis/Python 3.12 Playwright log fails five tests added or exercised by this PR: backend restart and cross-site iframe waits time out, ping reads time out, and cleanup reports 'Timeout should be used inside a task'. The gate log confirms both integration-app-harness and integration-app-harness-playwright failed; this is a current-head code/test blocker, not only gate propagation.

The benchmark run completes 132 tests but errors in test_on_event_router_data because reflex_base.context.base raises LookupError for the EventContext ContextVar. The performance gate merely propagates benchmarks=failure; browser-performance and lighthouse succeeded.

The older Reflex 0.8.23 playground cannot import SQLAlchemy asyncio because greenlet is missing. This is an old-version dependency-environment failure, separate from the current-head integration and benchmark failures.

The gate logs contain no independent test failure: they fail because their discover, build, check-min-deps, changes, install, and example jobs were cancelled. These are downstream cancellation propagation from the same interrupted workflow set.
